population.survivorship: Current listings and current SEC ticker map only. Delisted/acquired issuers in the window are absent. Results are conditional on survival to 2026-10-26 and current classification.

inference.limitation: Asymptotic interval; clusters must be justified independently. Overlapping horizons and few clusters can invalidate inference.

limitations: Block count is a design diagnostic, never an estimated effective sample size or proof of independent clusters.
Calendar dates with zero events stay in the resampling population; all instruments on each date move together.
Weak stationarity/mixing and block sufficiency are assumptions; structural change, selection and long dependence can invalidate nominal inference.
Centered bootstrap p-values are approximate; the add-one correction only controls Monte Carlo resolution, not inferential size.

methodValidity.criterion: Positive control DETECTED iff A1 mean > 0, Holm-adjusted p < 0.05 AND block-bootstrap 95% CI for A1 excludes 0. Otherwise NOT_DETECTED (reported as such).

preEntryMoveMarketAdjusted.meaning: Last close at/before SEC acceptance -> entry close (first close strictly after acceptance), minus SPY. Large |move| for PRE_OPEN/REGULAR acceptances shows information already priced before the entry close: next-close entry is look-ahead-free relative to acceptance but late relative to the market reaction.

clustering.note: Earnings-season concentration: few dates carry most events; overlapping 20-bar windows across dates make the cross-date dependence material, motivating date clustering and 20-session calendar blocks.
